√ Radicals根式

Simplifying & ordering radicals根式化简与比较大小

Which is bigger, 35​ or 211​? Without a calculator it looks like a guess — move the outside numbers inside the root and the answer is obvious.35​ 和 211​ 哪个大？不用计算器像在猜——把根号外的数挪进根号里，一眼就看出来。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 30 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Simplifying & ordering radicals根式化简与比较大小
  1. Pull out the LARGEST perfect square (perfect cube for 3 ​): 72​=62​.提出最大的完全平方因数（立方根提完全立方数）：72​=62​。
  2. Mixed → entire: square the outside number and multiply it in: 35​=45​.最简根式化为整根式：把外面的数平方后乘进去：35​=45​。
  3. To compare radicals, rewrite all as entire radicals and compare the insides.比较根式大小：都化成整根式，比较根号里面的数。
ab​=a​b​(a,b≥0)
kna​=nkna​

🧗 The hard part难点 · Simplifying & ordering radicals根式化简与比较大小

Radicals with variables含字母的根式化简

Odd powers must be split into an even part plus one, and the restriction is easy to forget.奇次幂要拆成偶次幂乘一次，而且容易忘写限制条件。

  1. Split into square pieces: 48x5y2=16x4y2⋅3x拆出平方部分：48x5y2=16x4y2⋅3x
  2. Root each square: 16x4y2​=4x2y (y≥0)对平方部分开方：16x4y2​=4x2y（y≥0）
  3. Leftover stays inside: 4x2y3x​, x≥0剩下的留在根号里：4x2y3x​，x≥0
  4. Odd index: no restriction, and negatives come out: 3−8a3​=−2a奇次根：没有限制，负号可以提出来：3−8a3​=−2a
Try试一试
Simplify 3−16a7​.化简 3−16a7​。
Answer答案
−16a7=(−8a6)(2a), so −2a232a​; no restriction (odd index).−16a7=(−8a6)(2a)，所以结果是 −2a232a​；奇次根，无限制。

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Simplifying & ordering radicals根式化简与比较大小
  • 72​=218​ is not finished → 62​.72​=218​ 没化完 → 62​。
  • 9+16​=3+4 ✗ → 25​=5. Roots split over ×, never over +.9+16​=3+4 ✗ → 25​=5。根号只能对乘法拆，不能对加法拆。
🎯
Know squares to 152 and cubes to 63 by heart — that is most of the speed.背熟 152 以内的平方数和 63 以内的立方数，速度就上来了。

√ Radicals根式

Operations with radicals根式的四则运算

A calculator says 3​−223​+1​≈−16.66, but a test wants the exact value. One multiplication by the "conjugate" turns it into −8−53​.计算器显示 3​−223​+1​≈−16.66，但考试要精确值。乘一次「共轭式」，就能化成 −8−53​。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 35 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Operations with radicals根式的四则运算
  1. Add/subtract LIKE radicals only — simplify each first: 12​+27​=53​.只有同类根式才能加减——先逐个化简：12​+27​=53​。
  2. Multiply outside × outside, inside × inside; expand brackets like FOIL.相乘：系数乘系数，根号里乘根号里；括号像多项式一样展开。
  3. Rationalize: ×b​b​​; binomial bottom → × conjugate, (a+b​)(a−b​)=a2−b.分母有理化：单项乘 b​b​​；二项分母乘共轭式，(a+b​)(a−b​)=a2−b。
mna​⋅knb​=mknab​
(a​+b​)(a​−b​)=a−b

🧗 The hard part难点 · Operations with radicals根式的四则运算

Rationalizing a binomial denominator二项式分母的有理化

You must pick the conjugate, multiply top AND bottom, then simplify a messy top.要选对共轭式、分子分母同乘，最后还要整理杂乱的分子。

  1. 3−3​6​⋅3+3​3+3​​
  2. Bottom: 32−(3​)2=6 — no middle term分母：32−(3​)2=6，没有中间项
  3. Top 6(3+3​); cancel 6: 3+3​分子 6(3+3​)；约去 6：3+3​
Try试一试
Rationalize 5​−15​+1​.把 5​−15​+1​ 的分母有理化。
Answer答案
5−1(5​+1)2​=46+25​​=23+5​​

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Operations with radicals根式的四则运算
  • 2​+3​=5​ ✗ → unlike radicals stay as they are.2​+3​=5​ ✗ → 不同类根式不能合并。
  • (3−2​)2=9+2 ✗ → 9−62​+2=11−62​.(3−2​)2=9+2 ✗ → 9−62​+2=11−62​。
🎯
After rationalizing, divide EVERY top term by a common factor of the bottom, or none.有理化后约分，要么分子每一项都除，要么都不除。

√ Radicals根式

Radical equations & extraneous roots根式方程与增根

Solve x+3​=x−3 by squaring and you get x=1 and x=6 — but plug in x=1 and you get 2=−2. Squaring can invent answers; this topic shows you how to catch them.两边平方解 x+3​=x−3，得到 x=1 和 x=6——可把 x=1 代回去却得 2=−2。平方会「造出」假答案，这一节教你怎样揪出来。

Difficulty难度 ●●●
⏱ 45 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Radical equations & extraneous roots根式方程与增根
  1. Restrictions → ISOLATE the radical → raise to the index → solve → CHECK in the original.写限制条件 → 孤立根式 → 两边乘方 → 解方程 → 代回原方程检验。
  2. Squaring can create extraneous roots: reject any root that fails the original.平方可能产生增根：不满足原方程的根要舍去。
  3. …​≥0: so x​=−4 has no solution, and …​=x−3 needs x≥3.…​≥0：所以 x​=−4 无解，…​=x−3 要求 x≥3。
A​=B ⇒ A=B2,valid only if B≥0

🧗 The hard part难点 · Radical equations & extraneous roots根式方程与增根

Two radicals: square twice两个根式：要平方两次

After the first squaring a radical is still there, and squaring a sum makes a middle term.第一次平方后还剩一个根式，而且和的平方会多出中间项。

  1. Isolate one radical: x+5​−x​=1 ⇒ x+5​=1+x​先孤立一个根式：x+5​−x​=1 ⇒ x+5​=1+x​
  2. Square: x+5=1+2x​+x平方：x+5=1+2x​+x
  3. Isolate again: 2x​=4, x​=2, x=4再孤立：2x​=4，x​=2，x=4
  4. Check: 9​−4​=1 ✓检验：9​−4​=1 ✓
Try试一试
Solve 2x+1​−x​=1.解方程 2x+1​−x​=1。
Answer答案
2x+1=1+2x​+x ⇒ x=2x​ ⇒ x2=4x ⇒ x=0 or 4; both check ✓.2x+1=1+2x​+x ⇒ x=2x​ ⇒ x2=4x ⇒ x=0 或 4；两个都检验通过 ✓。

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Radical equations & extraneous roots根式方程与增根
  • Squaring before isolating: (x​+1)2=x+1 ✗ → x+2x​+1.没孤立就平方：(x​+1)2=x+1 ✗ → x+2x​+1。
  • (2x+4​)2=2(x+4) ✗ → 4(x+4).(2x+4​)2=2(x+4) ✗ → 4(x+4)。
🎯
Write "Check:" with each root and ✓/✗ — that line often earns its own mark.写「检验：」把每个根代入并标 ✓/✗——这一行常常单独给分。

cards.b: Same index AND same radicand (after simplifying).根指数相同且被开方数相同（化简之后）。

cards.f: What is an extraneous root?什么是增根？
cards.b: A value that solves the squared equation but NOT the original. Reject it.满足平方后的方程、却不满足原方程的值，要舍去。

cards.f: First move on 2x+1​−3=x?见到 2x+1​−3=x 第一步？
cards.b: Isolate: 2x+1​=x+3, then square.移项：2x+1​=x+3，再平方。

cards.f: Restriction for 6−2x​?6−2x​ 的限制条件？
cards.b: 6−2x≥0, so x≤3.6−2x≥0，即 x≤3。

cards.f: Do cube-root equations make extraneous roots?立方根方程会产生增根吗？
cards.b: No — cubing keeps the sign. Still check your arithmetic.不会——立方保留符号。但仍要检查计算。

cards.f: x−1​+5=2: solution?x−1​+5=2 的解？
cards.b: None: x−1​=−3 is impossible.无解：x−1​=−3 不可能。
